analysis:
Both changed files are test-only Swift files under provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests, so they ship no runtime code and add no attack surface.

1. ClusterApprovalServiceStartTests.swift (head lines 14-61, 116-154): The tests add an optional `supervised` flag that injects an `environment` into ClusterService. They check that a coordinator-paired member part never inherits the service's heartbeat file path and instead gets its own `partHealthPath`. They also check that an unsupervised service passes no heartbeat file, and that an empty name stays empty. The behaviour is about supervisor liveness (availability, as in T-043's watchdog context), not about confidentiality or authorization. The tests do not weaken any App Attest, TB-011 or TB-002 control. The production changes (ClusterService.partEnvironment, ClusterService(environment:), ClusterServiceAgent.partHealthPath) are not in the supplied batch, so I could not check them. The tests only assert the intended contract.

2. ClusterOwnerServingTests.swift (head lines 68-121): The tests cover a new `ClusterPublicModels.declared` mechanism, under which an owner-declared public model is reported as 'qualified for public traffic' in its declared pipeline and tensor-parallel families even without a qualification record. The tests expect that a different artifact, a different mode family, or an undeclared model stays 'not yet qualified', and that passing `publicModels: []` restores record-only behaviour. The line text states that the coordinator's parity qualification still decides each placement. The production change widens how the public-traffic line and the public grant are derived, which could matter for trust-gating of public traffic (T-052, T-054-style qualification overclaiming). That code (ClusterPairServingGrants, ClusterPublicModels) is not supplied, so I cannot confirm that a declared-without-record model is not granted public traffic locally beyond the display line and the coordinator-side gate. The tests do assert that the artifact binding is enforced.

No finding qualifies from test-only changes. The next pass should review the production implementation of ClusterPublicModels.declared, publicTrafficLine and ownerServing.publicGrant, and ClusterService.partEnvironment, if they appear in other batches.
